title: waiting page: answered cards shrink; rail chips, pictures and the Sent bar fit at every width
why: Defect, Oct 28 13:19 CDT (shiv, screenshot of item 47 after his answer): an answered card, filing pending, shows as a huge empty green box; the left overview's chip lists run past the rail and show as clipped rows over the page edge. Second report 13:17 CDT (two screenshots, zoomed out against normal zoom): at a wide viewport the rail's chips overlap the cards, and an option's phone mockup covers its card's text.
note: Slug receipt-keeps-height-forever (orchestrator, Oct 28). Next cloud lane, claude-settings only; red test first for each part, design reviewer verdict per width. Part 1: a receipt keeps its old height (page.html 754-759) until reload; keep it only while in view, then drop the min-height (IntersectionObserver) and compensate scroll; test: answer a card, scroll it out, it shrinks with no shift. Part 2: at wide viewports the rail's .pairchips frames and chips grow past the 240px rail and overlap the cards; size them to the rail, never to their text (ellipsis). Part 3: at a wide viewport an option picture (.opts.pics) covers its card's text; it fits inside its card. Part 4: a containment sweep, widths 320 to 2560, both themes, every item state: no element leaves its card or the rail (shiv: a page built well needs no design pass per defect). Tests for 2 and 3 at 2200px and 1280. Part 5 (shiv, 13:22 CDT, the Sent bar): spacing feels mid, so stamp, line, item chip, Undo and Close go on the 4 px grid; the stamp animates too much (page.html 233-236: scale 2 to 1, overshoot curve, 0.42 s), so calm it. No earlier stamp flag found in steps, outbox or hand-offs. Same files as c186, c135, c136; lands ahead of them. Port: yes. Needs no answer. Owner questions, Oct 28 15:20 CDT (triage 12): waiting-page items 54 (picture height, cap 480 or fill), 55 (the 120 px floor, which is a minimum WIDTH, not height) and 56 (phone chips 32 or 44 px); pick a on each, so #783 ships as built. Mockups: docs/design/c193-choices.html, commit c1bfbc3 on origin branch worktree-agent-a14b2fddf62c05643.
